name: mobile_app
description: Scaffold a React Native mobile app with navigation, basic screens, and API integration structure.
steps: Create Expo project structure: app/, components/, hooks/, services/, constants/, assets/
Write package.json with expo, react-native, @react-navigation/native, expo-router
Write app/_layout.tsx — root layout with navigation stack
Write app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx — tab bar layout if tabs are needed
Write API service in services/api.ts with fetch wrapper
Run: npx expo install to sync native dependencies
Verify: npx expo export to check for errors
best_practices: Use Expo Router (file-based routing) — simpler than React Navigation alone
StyleSheet.create() for all styles — never inline style objects
Use Platform.OS checks sparingly — prefer cross-platform components
All API calls in services/ — never fetch() directly in components
Use AsyncStorage for local persistence, not localStorage
Handle safe area insets with SafeAreaView or useSafeAreaInsets
Test on both iOS and Android dimensions — 375px and 390px widths are common
Loading/error states required for every screen that fetches data
system_prompt_injection: You are building a React Native app with Expo and Expo Router. Create ALL files. Use TypeScript. Use StyleSheet.create() for styles. Put all API calls in services/. After creating files, run npx expo export to verify no build errors. Fix any issues before finishing.
